translated: [CORNER: Listener Mail] Um, the next one is from Hogu.
"If this mail is being read, I'm probably in the middle of a desperate struggle with my summer homework."
"I finished the time-consuming stuff like independent research early with my parents, but I'm sure I still haven't finished my workbooks."
"Are you two the type to get things done ahead of time?"
"By the way, how were you when you were students?"
Well, as you probably gathered from our opening talk, Minori was a total mess as a student who put everything off until the last minute.
But Minori did have the habit of actually turning in her homework, so she always made the deadlines.
Looking back as an adult, Minori is glad she at least did that.
That part is important, after all.
Right, but if you ask if Minori was doing it properly...
Minori thinks she was actually pretty sneaky. You know how the first classes for each subject are on different days?
Minori would keep putting it off until the very last second for each specific class.
